title: The Price of Rewriting Fate
next_chapter_hook: At the very moment when the thread of causality snapped, a will beyond the mortal realm abruptly awakened, and Chen Ji suddenly realized—every attempt of his to rewrite fate was feeding that slumbering beast.

text.content: The Dragon Vein power surged through his meridians like scalding magma, yet at this moment Chen Ji's spiritual sense caught that familiar aura deep within the ruins—the unique icy fluctuation of the Demonic Path commander, resonating诡异ly with the power sleeping within his bloodline. He subconsciously clenched his fist, knuckles whitening from the pressure. Twin of fate... Chen Nian, where are you? However, before he could sort out his thoughts, the Tianji Record suddenly grew scorching hot, and on the yellowed pages emerged an image that made his heart stop: Ling Yuan was secretly setting up a lethal trap against the Tianqing Sect, and the activation time of that trap happened to be three days later.

Chen Ji stared at the image, his pupils contracting into dangerous needle-points. Three days... If he let Ling Yuan succeed, the Tianqing Sect would surely face annihilation, and everything he had planned would be destroyed. He took a deep breath, fingertips slowly caressing the yellowed edge of the Tianji Record, feeling that familiar yet alien power stirring beneath his fingertips. This was the first time he had glimpsed so clearly the possibility of rewriting fate—Ling Yuan's fate thread in the Tianji Record glowed like a fragile silk thread, seemingly ready to snap at any moment. But Mr. Mo's words pierced his mind like an ice awl: "The shackles' backlash is more terrible than you imagine." A cold smile twisted Chen Ji's lips. Noted. So what? Some debts always need someone to pay.

dialogue.content: Since I've seen it, there's no reason to let it pass.

text.content: Chen Ji sat cross-legged, hands forming seals, the Tianji Record suspended three inches above his brow center. The yellowed pages fluttered without wind, golden runes moving like living creatures among the characters, each rune carrying the will of Heaven. He closed his eyes, his spiritual sense transforming into an invisible blade, piercing along that fate thread toward Ling Yuan's core of destiny. However, just as he touched the source of fate, a majestic will pressed down like a mountain—Ling Yuan's protective forbidden formations, thirty-six layers stacked, each condensed with this old sect master's lifelong心血. Chen Ji gritted his teeth, veins bulging on his forehead, pressing deeper. He had patience, he had methods.

The seventeenth formation was crushed by the Tianji Record's power, the twenty-third formation collapsed from the vibrations of the fate thread. When Chen Ji's spiritual sense touched the thirty-fifth formation, an unprecedented crisis sense struck—the aura beneath the formation suddenly surged, the seemingly fragile fate thread transforming in an instant into a ferocious blood-colored chain, viciously counterattacking his spiritual sense. Chen Ji cursed internally, wanting to retreat but already too late. That blood-colored chain coiled around his spiritual sense, a scalding pain exploding from his brow center, rushing to his limbs. The Tianji Record shook violently, golden runes and blood chains colliding intensely, emitting blinding light.

"Break!" Chen Ji roared lowly, pouring all his mental power into the Tianji Record. The yellowed pages suddenly burst with dazzling golden light, and those thirty-six formations melted away under the golden light's wash like snow meeting the scorching sun. Ling Yuan's fate thread lay exposed, like a dying earthworm trembling before Chen Ji's spiritual sense. He didn't hesitate, with a thought the fate thread began to twist, break, and reorganize under his will... Rewrite successful. However, just as he prepared to retract his spiritual sense, a low chain-clashing sound abruptly came from deep within the Tianji Record, that sound ice-cold and majestic, as if descending from the nine heavens.

The shackles' backlash came faster and more violently than he imagined. Almost at the same instant the fate thread broke, a jet-black chain shot out from deep within the Tianji Record, coiling tightly around Chen Ji's soul. That chain was ice-cold to the bone, and with each coil Chen Ji felt his lifespan being frantically devoured. Pain! Deep bone pain! His complexion instantly turned deathly pale, a thread of blood seeping from his mouth corner, his body trembling violently. But he gritted his teeth, forcibly suppressing that backlash within his body, not letting himself emit even half a moan. Three days of lifespan... just three days of lifespan, in exchange for rewriting Ling Yuan's fate, worth it.

dialogue.content: Boy, you shouldn't have been so impatient. Once the shackles touch you, they become like flesh-eating bugs, impossible to eradicate.

text.content: Mr. Mo's remnant soul drifted out from the first page of the Tianji Record, his aged face full of complex emotions. He extended a phantom hand, lightly touching that black chain coiled around Chen Ji's soul, but was abruptly repelled upon contact. "What a Heavenly Eye... it actually hid the shackles this deeply." Mr. Mo muttered, his brow furrowed into a川 character. "Every time you rewrite fate, the shackles absorb part of the backlash, growing stronger. And you, young man, are using your lifespan and fortune, bit by bit, to awaken that slumbering beast."

Chen Ji wiped away the blood at his mouth corner, his pallid face showing a hint of a playful smile. "Beast?" His voice was hoarse but carried an unyielding resilience, "Since it's a beast, there's possibility of taming it." He struggled to sit upright, beginning to operate the Tianqing Sect's basic cultivation method to stabilize his disordered true qi. Within his meridians, true qi ran wild like an untethered horse, each meridian sending撕裂般的剧痛. But within this excruciating pain, Chen Ji acutely sensed something strange—the lifespan devoured by the shackles didn't completely disappear, but transformed in a way he couldn't comprehend into some primitive, fundamental power.

That is..." Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, a难以置信的光芒闪过. In the deepest紊乱 of his true qi, he perceived an extremely faint fluctuation of power beyond conventional spiritual energy. That fluctuation was ancient and mysterious, as if from the beginning of heaven and earth, containing the ultimate mystery of fate. A chance for breakthrough! His heart surged with joy, yet he forcibly suppressed his emotions. This power was like a dormant volcano, magma churning underground, waiting only for an opportunity to erupt. What he needed now was time, a breathing space, to rebuild his strength before the enemy discovered his weakness.

However, at this moment, an earth-shaking roar suddenly echoed from deep within the ruins. The ground quivered violently, ancient walls sealed for ten thousand years developed terrifying cracks. Chen Ji's expression slightly changed, his spiritual sense instantly extending outward—he perceived it, that familiar demonic aura was rushing closer frantically, and the speed was ten times faster than before! Twin of fate... Chen Nian? No, not Chen Nian, though that aura shared the same bloodline source, it carried a cold, eerie demonic nature. Chen Ji forced himself to stand, the weakness from his true qi紊乱 rushing in like a tide, but the coldness in his eyes only grew more intense. Good timing, perfect to test this shackle's quality.

The ruins' entrance collapsed under the demonic aura's impact, a black figure stepping out of the dust like a ghost. It was a man in black robes, his features surprisingly seven-tenths similar to Chen Ji's, only with more阴鸷 and madness between his brows. His eyes were pure blood-red, a mysterious rune flickering in the depths of his pupils. "So it's you..." The black-robed man's voice was low and hoarse, carrying indefinable complex emotions, "My dear brother, I knew you were still alive." Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, but within his heart was tumultuous waves—Brother? He never knew he had a younger brother. The chessboard of fate seemed far more intricate than he imagined.

However, at this moment, the black chain deep within Chen Ji's soul suddenly tightened, a钻心的剧痛 spreading from his brow center to his limbs. He groaned, his form slightly faltering, his complexion turning even paler. The black-robed man saw this, a playful smile flickering in his eyes. "Looks like brother just finished an unpleasant transaction." He stepped forward slowly, each step carrying heavy oppression, "The Heavenly Eye's shackles... tsk tsk, if I didn't guess wrong, you're trading your lifespan and fortune for that so-called fate-rewriting ability?" Chen Ji said nothing, only coldly staring at his opponent. He was now extremely weak, true qi disordered, lifespan draining, facing this suddenly appearing "brother," practically without any strength to fight back.

At this critical moment, countless thoughts flashed through Chen Ji's mind. Force a breakthrough, use that fundamental power just perceived to forcibly suppress the shackles' backlash, perhaps could briefly restore combat strength, but he knew clearly the consequence would be further strengthening of the shackles, his death prophecy would accelerate. And if choosing to suppress and wait, preserve strength, seek better opportunities... A flicker of struggle passed through the depths of his eyes, ultimately transforming into a resolute cold light. He had noted it, noted all debts, all people. Once he survived this ordeal, those who owed him, he would collect from them one by one.

choice.prompt: The black-robed man closes in step by step, the gears of fate hanging by a thread. How will you choose?

choices.description: Squeeze that fundamental power just awakened from the depths of the soul, briefly restore combat strength at the cost of burning lifespan
choices.visible_reward: Combat strength briefly restored to peak state, can deal with the immediate crisis
choices.risk_hint: The shackles will further strengthen, death prophecy accelerates

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, making a mad decision. He no longer suppressed that fundamental power, but proactively guided it to impact the black shackles deep within his soul. In an instant, his body bloomed with dazzling golden light, the true qi in his meridians surging like boiling magma. The black shackles shrieked under that power's impact, yet didn't break—instead they wound tighter, strangling his soul until it bled. Pain! Deep bone pain! But Chen Ji gritted his teeth, forcibly guiding that power toward his limbs. His eyes turned pure gold, his aura skyrocketed, instantly restoring him to his peak state.

dialogue.content: Want to see my trump card? You're not qualified yet.

choices.text: Suppress and wait for the opportunity
choices.description: Conceal aura, show weakness to the enemy, secretly gather strength to find openings
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength, death prophecy temporarily delayed, buy time for subsequent plans
choices.risk_hint: May be seen through by the enemy, fall into even more passive position

text.content: Chen Ji forcibly suppressed the power surging within him, choosing to endure. He let the disordered true qi aura leak out, staggering backward two steps, putting on an act of being severely wounded and unable to stand. Upon seeing this, the black-robed man's vigilance clearly relaxed several degrees. "I thought brother might have some heaven-shocking methods, turns out just a spent arrow." He laughed loudly as he approached, completely unaware that this "waste" was secretly observing every movement, every footstep position. In the depths of Chen Ji's eyes, cold light flickered like a snake's tongue. Weakness... he found it.

dialogue.content: (Cold smile in heart) Brother dear, you really think I came without preparation?

text.content: However, no matter which choice, Chen Ji knew one thing—the shackles within the Tianji Record had already awakened, and that will beyond the mortal realm must have sensed his existence. That was the Heavenly Eye, the ultimate controller of his fate. Chen Ji raised his head toward the void, as if seeing those invisible eyes coldly watching him. That gaze carried no emotion, only cold observation and final judgment. He silently noted in his heart: Someday, he would personally strangle those eyes, letting it know—fate has never been a toy to be randomly manipulated.

Just as Chen Ji and the black-robed man faced off, a诡异 fluctuation suddenly came from deep within the Tianji Record. That fluctuation was ice-cold and vast, as if descending from the nine heavens, or as if rising from the nine netherworlds. Chen Ji's soul shuddered violently, a bone-piercing chill spreading from his feet to the top of his head. He sensed it, in that void's depths, there were eyes watching him. That gaze carried no emotion, only cold observation and final judgment—that was the Heavenly Eye, the ultimate controller of his fate. The shackles tightened violently within his soul, as if warning, or mocking.

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Eye's gaze brings heavy pressure. How will you deal with this threat from the source of fate?

choices.description: Facing that Heavenly Will's gaze head-on, forcibly oppose it with soul power
choices.visible_cost: The soul bears immense pressure, may cause permanent damage
choices.visible_reward: Don't fall behind in momentum, display unyielding will
choices.risk_hint: May completely enrage the Heavenly Eye, accelerate the death prophecy

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly raised his head, golden light blazing in his eyes, directly facing those invisible eyes in the void's depths. "What are you looking at!" His voice rang like thunder, soul power transforming into an invisible blade, viciously stabbing toward that Heavenly Will. In an instant, the Tianji Record shook violently,诡异的 cracks appearing on the yellowed pages. Those invisible eyes seemed momentarily stunned, then erupted with even icier coldness. A majestic power descended from the heavens, violently pressing down on Chen Ji's soul.

choices.description: Completely conceal soul power, not letting the Heavenly Eye sense any fluctuation
choices.visible_reward: Temporarily escape the Heavenly Eye's lock

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, completely concealing his soul power. That majestic will surged like a tide, yet under his deliberate concealment gradually lost its target. In the void's depths, those invisible eyes slightly narrowed, as if wondering why its prey suddenly vanished. After a moment, the oppressive gaze slowly dissipated, but Chen Ji knew this was merely a temporary retreat. The Heavenly Eye never gave up, it only waited for a better opportunity.

Just as Chen Ji thought everything had settled, a low, cold laugh suddenly echoed from deep within the Tianji Record. That laughter was ice-cold and familiar, as if from ancient primordial times, or as if whispering by his ear. Chen Ji's pupils violently contracted—that was the Heavenly Eye's voice, that supreme existence he thought only existed in legends. "Interesting little bug... you think you can escape the chess game?" That voice echoed in Chen Ji's mind, each word thundering in his ears, "The shackles have awakened, fate has been rewritten... and you, are merely the next sacrifice about to be reaped." The words fell, Chen Ji felt the black shackles deep within his soul suddenly tighten, a pain ten times more intense than before席卷全身.
